items.en_title: Montes Claros (MG) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #016
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Montes Claros (MG) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 88,527,614.4; proposals close Nov 27, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
